name: István Kovács
bio: István's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, fueled by a childhood spent tinkering with his grandfather's aging Lada. While his peers pursued traditional academic paths, István enrolled in a vocational program specializing in precision machining. His meticulous attention to detail quickly set him apart, earning him a reputation for crafting flawless components. After years honing his skills in the manufacturing sector, István yearned to apply his expertise to the high-stakes world of racing. He landed an entry-level position, eager to learn the ropes and contribute his unique blend of old-world craftsmanship and modern techniques to a winning team. He believes that the smallest details can make the biggest difference on the track, and he is committed to perfecting every part he touches.

physical.description: István is of average height with a sturdy build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and calculations.
Insists on using traditional measuring tools alongside digital instruments.
Has a habit of whistling classical music while working.
